teaching_clarity.rationale: One synthetic transfer episode turns nominal approval, informed review, effective intervention, and meaningful control into distinct visible states, then demonstrates the oversight contract, eight-condition envelope, time budget, workload failure, fail-closed alternatives, exercised stop path, and bounded responsibility rule.

composition.rationale: All 87 caption-boundary frames and 90 start-middle-end beat samples preserve readable hierarchy among the episode, reviewer, envelope, clocks, baseline rail, task check, control channel, receipt, responsibility ceiling, privacy boundary, evidence airlock, and final epistemic-security handoff.

motion_quality.rationale: The abnormal-case token traverses the automation funnel; necessary conditions are scanned independently; time is visibly consumed; the safe-hold route is exercised; responsibility meets a hard ceiling; admission expires; and the opening episode resolves through task-grounded motion rather than decorative text.

synchronization.rationale: Thirty audio-derived beats, the exact 347.060-second narration boundary, 87 caption cues, and exhaustive representative-frame review agree. Late-arriving contract, time-budget, baseline, adaptive, receipt, responsibility, and privacy objects found in revision five were retimed before acceptance.

continuity.rationale: The transfer episode, reviewer, eight-segment control envelope, intervention path, safe-hold basin, and provenance-linked receipt retain stable identities while their state changes; the final scene returns to the exact opening choice and hands its vulnerability record to the next chapter.

pacing.rationale: The 728-word narration runs at about 126 words per minute. Longer paragraph-level beats contain clause-level motion, and the apparent automated freeze flags were manually traced to continuous small-object motion at the funnel, rung ladder, and exercised channel rather than inert exposition.

voice.rationale: The narration is concrete, careful, and non-anthropomorphic: a click is not control; task evidence is not a person score; telemetry cannot certify a normative state; and responsibility cannot exceed recorded authority, time, alternatives, and intervention.

sound_mix.rationale: The narration-only animatic decodes cleanly at 48 kilohertz mono and measures minus 16.4 LUFS integrated, 3.0 LU range, and minus 1.4 dBTP, with no detected three-second silence.

engagement.rationale: The opening 12-versus-14-second dilemma invites a prediction, the automation funnel exposes the human handoff problem, the control keys fail independently of fluent presentation, the intervention is exercised rather than asserted, and the final safe-hold payoff resolves the opening choice.

accessibility.rationale: Every state duplicates color with labels, shape, position, line style, enclosure, or explicit crossing. The descriptive transcript covers material visual changes, the captions pass all 87 representative frames, and the thumbnail remains legible at reduced size without encoding meaning by color alone.

claim_fidelity.rationale: The video explicitly limits repository evidence to finite record routing: schema, fixture, rejecting mutations, and bounded formal model. It denies inference to comprehension, workload thresholds, human efficacy, responsibility, deployment, safety, or transfer, and routes the synthetic episode for task reasons rather than scoring a person.

non_claim: Rejected animatics r1 through r5 remain preserved in ignored generation history. Passing revision six records a chapter-specific audiovisual teaching candidate only; picture-and-sound lock, release candidate, independent review, publication, and any book-evidence promotion remain ungranted.
